summary: Iteration 16: Telegram Bot Management System - All backend tests PASSED (25/25). Frontend Telegram Tab renders correctly showing Auth flow screen.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Telegram tab renders auth flow as expected)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Telegram auth requires real phone verification which is not available in test environment. All API endpoints tested and working. Frontend shows auth flow correctly. Bot creation endpoints will fail gracefully without auth.

GET /api/admin/telegram/auth/status.response: Returns authenticated=false (expected - no phone verification done)

GET /api/admin/telegram/stats.response: Returns total_bots, active_bots, total_subscribers, pending_bots, failed_bots

GET /api/admin/telegram/bots.response: Returns list of bots with search filter support

GET /api/admin/telegram/firm-bot-map.response: Returns 264 firms mapped with potential bot usernames (format: {firm}_guncel2026_bot)

POST /api/admin/telegram/create-bot.response: Validates firm_id, returns 404 for invalid firm, accepts creation request

POST /api/admin/telegram/create-bulk.response: Handles empty firm list, returns 404 when no firms specified

POST /api/admin/telegram/broadcast.response: Requires message and bot target, returns 404 when no active bots

DELETE /api/admin/telegram/bot/{bot_id}.response: Returns 404 for non-existent bot, requires auth

POST /api/telegram/webhook/{bot_id}.response: Public endpoint - accepts empty updates, returns ok=true

GET /api/stats/dashboard.response: Includes telegram_bots count in dashboard stats

frontend_telegram_tab.details: Shows auth flow with phone input when not authenticated

frontend_dashboard_telegram_stat.details: Telegram Bot count (1) shown in dashboard stats with purple styling

mocked_apis.note: Telegram BotFather automation requires real Telegram account auth. Bot creation endpoints will fail gracefully without phone verification. This is expected behavior.
